title: Add-On Down Payment for an Invoice Added to a Patient Payment Plan
content:
On **Patient Payment Plans**, an add-on down payment is owed when an invoice is added to a plan already accepted whose term carries a down payment, that is a term whose down-payment percentage is above zero; on a term without a down payment none is owed. It is paid by the patient, it belongs to the invoice being added, and it is posted on the plan ledger as a down payment dated the day it is paid.

## Where it applies

| Term of the accepted plan | Down-payment percentage above zero | Add-on down payment owed on an added invoice |
|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Payment Plan, 18-Month Payment Plan, 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | Yes | Yes |
| 3-Month Payment Plan, 6-Month Payment Plan, 9-Month Payment Plan | No | None |

## What the payment does
The patient pays, with their own payment method, the down payment that goes with a bill being added to their payment plan. One payment posts one line on the plan's activity, marked as a down payment dated today, and lowers the plan's remaining balance by the amount paid. The plan's status, installment and due day are not changed. The patient sees the payment on the plan straight away, together with a payment reference.

## How it is invoked
The payment is made through the customer-side tool `pay_add_on_down_payment_958d6e13`. It is the patient's own act: the agent unlocks the tool for the patient with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with their own payment method.

## Parameters

- `plan_id` — the reference number of the patient's payment plan, as the payment-plan lookup shows it.
- `amount` — the amount the patient pays, in USD: a positive number to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent.
- `payment_method` — how the patient pays; exactly one of:
  - `credit_card` — a credit card;
  - `debit_card` — a debit card;
  - `ach_bank_transfer` — a checking or savings account, by bank transfer;
  - `check` — a mailed paper check;
  - `hsa_fsa_card` — a health savings or flexible spending account card.

## Return
On success the tool returns `payment_id` (the reference of the posted payment), `plan_id`, `amount_paid` (USD to 2 decimal places) and `plan_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the plan's remaining balance once the payment is applied). A returned `payment_id` means the payment was posted.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)
A patient on an accepted 12-Month Payment Plan pays an add-on down payment of 31.25 by bank transfer: `plan_id` is the plan's reference, `amount` is 31.25 and `payment_method` is `ach_bank_transfer`. The plan's activity then shows a down-payment line of 31.25 dated that day, and the receipt shows the lowered plan balance.
